notes.title: Update week 2
notes.content:

notes.title: Mazeing Week 1 update
notes.content:
I hope you enjoy my game. I will try to update weekly, but keep in mind that I do it alone.
Patch notes:
Performance boost on bigger labyrinths
Bigger labyrinths avalible(150 by 150)
Pillars' color changes
Map nerfed(has smaller area and maxes out at 80 by 80 size)
--added--
Timer
Loops(you can get to a point by 2 or more ways)
Switch minigame
--bugfixes--
Closing map made player small
Some words weren't translated into english


If you find any bugs feel free to tell me through steam.
Have fun with this new content.
